title: OutputRowsResponse
description: Response for GET /api/outputs/:id/rows?offset=&limit=&sort=&filter= (HEL-906 cycle 7, extended HEL-1027, extended HEL-1188). `sort` (`<column>:<asc|desc>`) and `filter` (URL-encoded JSON `{quick?, columns?, ops?}`, matching `TableColumnFilters`' case-insensitive substring semantics plus HEL-1188's range/equality/list-membership `ops` entries: `{column, op: "eq"|"in"|"gte"|"lte", value?, values?}`) are query parameters, not part of this body -- see openspec/specs/output-routes-api/spec.md for their full contract, including `ops`' eq/in eligibility gate (GET /api/outputs/:id/filter-capabilities). HEL-1027: when `filter` is present and non-empty, `total` reflects the count of rows matching the filter (not the Output's raw row count) -- the same value the client derives `hasMore` from (`offset + limit < total`). HEL-1188: `ops` entries are ANDed with `quick`/`columns` and with each other, so this same `total`/`hasMore` derivation is unchanged by their addition -- only what counts as a match grows. `materialized` is independent of a filter's match count: `false` only when the bound node has never had a successful pipeline run at all -- a filter that legitimately matches zero rows of an Output with real data is `materialized: true`.

items.description: The requested page's rows, each an arbitrary JSON object keyed by column name.

total.description: Row count for the current `sort`/`filter` -- the Output's raw row count when `filter` is absent or empty, the filtered row count otherwise.

materialized.description: False only when the bound node has never had a successful pipeline run since the Output was added -- never derived from a filter's match count.
